# Bijay Rouniyar (Bijju) — Full Stack Web Developer

## Overview
Bijay Rouniyar (nickname: Bijju) is a Full Stack Web Developer based in Biratnagar, Morang, Koshi Province, Nepal. He builds fast, responsive websites and modern web applications with React, TypeScript, and Node.js.

## Location & Service Areas
- Base: Biratnagar, Morang, Koshi Province, Nepal (NP)
- Service Areas: Biratnagar, Itahari, Dharan, Morang, Koshi Province, across Nepal, and remote clients worldwide.

## Services
- Custom Web Development in Biratnagar & Koshi Province
- Modern Responsive Website Design across Nepal
- Freelance React & TypeScript Engineering
- E-commerce Website Development with Nepali Payment Workflows
